sourceExplanation.explanation: HDRPipelineProcessor passes modelURL=nil at strength0; HDRRuntimeResources.reserve returns nil before model file lookup or reservation. NativeHDRProcessor constructs its renderer only for a non-nil model URL. This fresh dedicated one-session process therefore reports zero reserved model payload bytes. The counter is process-wide immutable-weight reservation accounting, not total OS resident memory, MLX active bytes, or proof that imports/packing allocate nothing.
